Name: SleepingMatriarch
ShiftBefore: The oldest of the colossi lies on her side, asleep, dusk on her shoulder. She is cold and shivering. Her three zones hold a total light of 1.5 (1.0 + 0.5 + 0.0).
ShiftAfter: The Turning: warmed, she takes one long breath and rolls her shoulder a few degrees. The same 1.5 of light falls differently (0.85 + 0.4 + 0.25). Faint outlines (pentimenti) remain wherever something used to be.
Notes: Parent row. Zone rows below carry the real values. AmbientLight here is the average of the three zones. One persistent level streams the zone sublevels.

Name: VarnishVillage
ShiftBefore: A terraced village of about twelve houses on her sunward shoulder, fully painted and safe. Three terraces: the Sunward Terraces (Ochre nodes), the Lampstand square (Hesper, Bartram's Grinding Slab, the Armature Bench, the flax press), and the Hem (lowest houses, paint starting to flake).
ShiftAfter: Her shoulder has dropped. The Hem now lies in the shadow of her collarbone and becomes half-painted: bare canvas shows on its sun-away walls and its local light is 0.5 (plus any bonus from SQ_AFairGrind). Two Blotters appear in the Hem unless the Village_HemGuarded flag is set. The Stair of Spines now arrives at the village's lower gate.
Notes: Each Ochre node yields 2. Strokes are free here before the shift (ambient 1.0). No combat before the shift. Same geometry in A and B: B changes lighting, swaps the Hem's materials, tilts the Hem 4 degrees and adds the lower gate.

Name: Scumblewood
ShiftBefore: A forest growing between the vertebrae of her spine, painted only on the side that faces the sun. The route from Varnish winds down the Furrow, a gorge between two vertebrae, past the First Well, the Sunward Clearing (Corin) and the Hollow Vertebra (brood nest) to the Rib Gate. The Nape Overlook is visible above but cannot be reached. 6 Madderbacks, 6 Blotters.
ShiftAfter: Her spine has arched. The Furrow has closed (the First Well is sealed inside it; its pentimento outline remains on the rock). Five vertebrae have risen into the Stair of Spines: a direct climb from the Rib Gate to Varnish's lower gate, with a branch to the Nape Overlook (cache: 2 Slumber Blue, 3 Shed Hide, and the first sight of the next colossus on the horizon). Enemy positions are reshuffled; counts follow the quest flags.
Notes: Each node yields 2. Lampstands: Sunward Clearing and Rib Gate. One-sided rule: surfaces facing the sun (west) are painted and solid; some sun-away faces are bare canvas and can be walked through. This is the zone that gets a true alternate layout: about 30% of its modular chunks move between A and B.

Name: GrisailleVault
ShiftBefore: The inside of her ribcage, which the god only ever drew. Grey paper, graphite line, hatching for shadow, construction lines still showing. Three spaces: the Rib Stair (entry), the Cartoon Gallery (sketched platforms that are solid only while lit) and the Heart (boss arena). 6 Pentiments, 4 Blotters, Old Palimpsest.
ShiftAfter: The Heart is beating warm again. A first thin amber glaze lies over the grey: the Vault's ambient light rises to 0.25 and colour tints the drawings nearest the Heart. Sketched platforms within 20 m of the Heart are now permanently solid. No enemies respawn here in the slice.
Notes: Each node yields 2. Slumber Blue nodes never regrow. Sketch rules: gravity 0.6x, no fall damage, sketched objects are solid only while lit by a Flare (8 s) or fixed by a Fixative Flask (permanent). Lampstand: Rib Stair, just before the Heart. Same geometry in A and B: B changes lighting and materials only.
